data_output.description: The unchanged data pipeline must encode train and validation rows using training-derived vocabularies and preserve canonical validation row order. The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz with exactly two arrays: row_ids, equal to the canonical validation row identifiers/order expected by the evaluator, and scores, a one-dimensional finite prediction array of identical length. No ground-truth validation labels may be read by the fixed evaluator-facing output path except by the fixed evaluator itself.

model_input.description: Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2) must retain the existing interface. Initialize user_weights, item_weights, and user_embeddings as before, but initialize only item_embeddings with seeded normal noise using standard deviation 0.01; user_embeddings must remain all zeros. The seed must deterministically control this initialization, and both embedding tables must remain trainable under the unchanged pointwise binary cross-entropy, Adam-like optimizer, L2 regularization, batching, split, and early-stopping behavior. logits, step, predict, state, and load_state interfaces must remain compatible with train.py.
